description: This file provides an interface for integrating with the WhisperX model for subtitle processing, including a function to run WhisperX on an input file and generate subtitle data.

methods.name: List[dict] run_whisperx_on_file(input_path: str)
methods.description: Simulates calling the WhisperX model to generate subtitles from an input file. Returns a list of subtitle dictionaries with start/end times and text.
